text.en:
Our Quality Policy

Hanbros UK's quality policy is built on one principle: customer satisfaction at the highest level, achieved through measurable standards and continuous improvement. Every UK collection, every customs file and every delivery in Turkey is handled against defined procedures — not left to chance.

Quality Commitments

  • Packing & loading: Trained crews, appropriate materials and load securing for international transit.
  • Documentation: Accurate invoices, packing lists and customs declarations — errors cause delays; precision is quality.
  • Partner standards: Vetted carriers, warehouses and agents in the UK, transit countries and Turkey.
  • Complaint handling: Documented investigation, root-cause analysis and corrective action within agreed timeframes.
  • Review cycle: Regular audit of routes, damage rates, delivery performance and customer feedback scores.

Quality is not a department — it is how every Hanbros UK team member treats your shipment from first contact to final proof of delivery.
